exposure: hospital practices (e.g., BFHI status, pre-lacteal feeding)
outcome: breastfeeding at first hour of life
breastfeeding at two months of age
exclusive breastfeeding at two months of age
cohort: The study included 959 mothers and their babies from Rio de Janeiro, representing 1,537 puerperal women at baseline.
finding: Breastfeeding promotion policies have been effective in universalizing breastfeeding at two months, but to increase exclusive breastfeeding, expanding support, improving hospital practices, and reducing caesarean sections are necessary.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were associated with a higher frequency of pre-lacteal feeding, which negatively impacted both breastfeeding and exclusive breastfeeding.
